rows.grounds: dvāḥsthān (acc. pl., doorkeepers) + ca (and); L1/L2: worship of doorkeepers in the yāga sequence
pūjayet (opt., should worship) + antar (inside) + deva-agre (before the deity); L1/L2: ritual instruction to worship within, in front of the deity
kalpanā-kramāt (abl., from the order of arrangement/prescription); L1/L2: following the ritual sequence
kṣiptvā (gerund, having thrown) + astra-japtam (consecrated by mantra of the weapon); L1/L2: flower empowered with astra mantra and cast
kusumam (acc. sg., flower); L1/L2: ritual offering thrown in the rite
jvalat-veśmani (loc. sg., in the shining/blazing dwelling); L1/L2: location for casting the consecrated flower
vighna-nut (nom., dispeller of obstacles); L1/L2: describes the effect of the act; surface form uncertain in transmission
